# The Intentional Group

> A Dubai-based group of companies delivering property development, design and build interiors, education services, and landscaping across the UAE and beyond.

The Intentional Group grew out of Intentional Development and is now a family of companies united by shared values: Excellence, Transparency, Integrity, Respect, and Value. The group serves clients through its core businesses and initiates ventures where it identifies a genuine need, balancing commercial viability with community benefit.

## Location and contact

- Base: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Postal address: P.O. Box 72528, Dubai, UAE

## Businesses

- Intentional Development: Development Management and Project Management for industrial, port, airport, commercial and retail projects. Currently preparing the feasibility study and master plan for The Jubilee Community, a new intergenerational village in the UAE. https://intentional.ae/businesses/intentional-development/
- Intentional Interiors: Design and build fitout for offices, hotels, F&B outlets, residences and educational spaces, with full project management from concept to handover. https://intentional.ae/businesses/intentional-interiors/
- Intentional Education: Educational consulting, curriculum development, professional development for educators, and learning solutions for schools and institutions across the UAE. https://intentional.ae/businesses/intentional-education/
- Intentional Landscaping: Landscaping, tree surgery and outdoor living, delivered through two specialist companies, DXB Tree Specialists (https://dxbtreespecialists.ae) and Upgraded Landscaping (https://upgradedlandscaping.ae). Serves Dubai Hills Estate, Arabian Ranches, Emirates Hills and Palm Jumeirah. https://intentional.ae/businesses/intentional-landscaping/

## Events

- The Intentional Inclusion Celebration, a free family-friendly festival celebrating inclusion for People of Determination, the chronically ill, cancer survivors, and those living with mental health challenges. 3 December 2026, 2:00 to 7:00 PM, GEMS Dubai American Academy, Dubai. Everyone is welcome. https://tiic.intentional.ae/
